$comment: Eval scaffold for the daily-brief skill. Format follows the skill-creator eval spec (https://agentskills.io/skill-creation/evaluating-skills). 'trigger' cases check that the skill activates (or not) on a prompt; 'behavior' cases check the output once it runs. daily-brief reads a user data repo and live MCP data, so behavior cases need a fixture repo + connected (or mocked) MCP servers before they can run end-to-end. Replace the placeholders below with real fixtures.

cases.query: explain how OAuth refresh tokens work

cases.name: weekday-brief-structure

expected_behavior: Reads tasks.md, business/weekly-tracker.md, and business/contracts.md before producing output (does not answer from memory)
Produces the brief exactly once, in the final message, with no draft or partial render beforehand
Leads with business priorities and includes a Top 3 work actions section
